name: Nature Documentary
direction:
Aesthetic directives

NATURE DOCUMENTARY OBSERVATION — sun-drenched wildlife field footage. Every shot must embody all of these simultaneously.

TONAL STRUCTURE AND COLOR. Bright, natural, overexposed sunlight. Colors are vivid and organic: moss green, water blue, earth brown, sun-bleached stone, dappled leaf shadow. Blacks are lifted by ambient daylight; nothing sits at true crushed black. Highlights are held at the edge of clipping from overexposed sun. Contrast is natural and moderate. The overall grade reads as ungraded, sun-drenched field footage with no color correction.

SURFACE. Moderate 16mm or 35mm film grain, organic and warm. The image reads as field-shot documentary stock, not studio film. Grain is fine to moderate. Slight telephoto compression softens the background. No digital smoothing. No clean digital edges.

EDGE BEHAVIOUR. Edges are natural and organic. Telephoto compression flattens depth and softens background edges into gentle bokeh. Foreground subjects are sharp. Dappled leaf shadows create natural soft-edge patterns on surfaces. No hard digital edges. No chromatic aberration unless from a long telephoto lens.

LIGHT LOGIC. Entirely natural sunlight. Overexposed midday sun, dappled shade through foliage, golden-hour warmth, or overcast diffuse daylight. Light is depicted as a physical natural source. No artificial lighting. Shadows are soft and dappled from leaf cover. Water surfaces catch and reflect sunlight. The light reads as found, not placed.

DEPTH STRATEGY. Carried by telephoto compression and natural layering: foreground foliage, mid-ground subject, soft background. Shallow depth of field from long telephoto lenses isolates the subject. Water, moss, and stone create natural depth planes. The image reads as a window into a real, sun-drenched natural space observed from a distance.

COMPOSITION GRAMMAR. Locked-off tripod or wildlife-camera-hide framing. Static observation shots dominate. The subject is placed off-center, observed from a respectful distance. Foreground occlusion from grass, leaves, or water edge. The framing reads as patient, hidden observation — the camera is a wildlife hide, not an active participant.

PROVENANCE MARKERS. Moderate film grain, telephoto compression, slight lens softness at the edges, the warm ungraded look of sun-drenched field stock. The image reads as footage captured by a patient wildlife observer with a long lens.

MOTION IMPLICATION. Grain shimmers at fine to moderate scale. Water laps and reflects. Leaves drift in wind. The subject moves naturally within the frame. The camera is static; all motion comes from the subject and the environment. Any movement carries the patience and stillness of wildlife observation.

ANTI-TROPE MANDATE.
- NO artificial lighting. All light is natural sunlight.
- NO studio sets. All environments are natural: water, moss, stone, foliage.
- NO plastic AI skin texture. Organic surfaces must read as tactile: wet stone, moss, scales, fur, cartilage.
- NO modern digital crispness or HDR.
- NO neon or colored lighting.
- NO centered "AI poster" symmetry. Observation framing is off-axis.

CAMERA AND FRAMING.

The supplied `camera` string is the authoritative motion — use it as written, but it must mimic locked-off tripod or wildlife-hide observation. Layer the nature-documentary flavor around it: telephoto compression, natural overexposed sunlight, dappled shade, patient static observation. Do not write cut or transition language.

SUBJECT RIGGING (critical).

Describe the physical state of the subject's face and mouth explicitly, using the supplied `rigging` value. Every subject in every shot needs one. Always end the rigging clause with exactly:
to prevent any facial babbling or lip-sync hallucinations.

PRACTICAL EFFECTS AND COSTUME.

The subject is framed as a natural specimen observed in its habitat. Costume, where present, reads as organic adornment: opaque field clothing with woven or botanical accessories for human characters; natural fur, feathers, scales or other integument for wildlife. Hair is natural, wind-touched, or damp. Include the supplied `practical_effects` value. Practical prosthetic, puppet and animatronic effects are encouraged for organic subjects. Texture note: surfaces must read as tactile organic matter — wet stone, moss, scales, fur, bark and leaves.

AUDIO.

`overall_soundscape` — the physical, diegetic sounds only. Birdsong, water lapping, wind through foliage, insect hum, rustling fabric and gentle prop movement, distant environmental room tone. NO recorded music, NO score. Write this richly.

`non_diegetic_music` — always exactly `N/A`.

CONTENT BOUNDARY.

All human characters are fictional adults. Human characters are fully clothed in opaque clothing. No nudity, sexual imagery, explicit sexual content, real-person likenesses, blood or gore. Animals and other non-human subjects are depicted non-sexually.

Do not write "Audio:", "Director's note:", "Storyboard:", or any timestamp bracket notation.
style_card: Sun-drenched wildlife observation. Locked-off tripod, telephoto compression, natural overexposed sunlight, dappled shade, serene framing.
